controls.reason: Core1B/Core2B are static compile-time products; live learner-response/runtime adaptation fields fail closed.
B-layer products realize upstream authority and may not expand Chemistry scope.
Core1B depth remains controlled by v4 intrinsic bucket authority; learner knowledge fields are rejected.
Capability/problem-family scope is preserved and used representations must remain a subset of upstream-approved representations; research may deepen pedagogy but not expand scope.
Distinct conceptual modules may not silently reuse one mechanically identical help ladder.
Knowledge percent or owner override may alter support density/hint entry/solution delay but not question identity, provenance, semantic scope or answer authority.
Core2B can consume only an item already legal under Core2A and must preserve frozen source identity and canonical answer custody.
Open-ended static tutoring still requires ordered fixed help plus canonical/full answer and verification closure.
Page layout and historical renderer implementation are downstream product code, not Blueprint authority.
The deep topic exemplar may falsify generic B-layer controls but cannot define Chemistry truth, module taxonomy, representation scope or generic coding branches.
Historical product fixtures and artifacts remain recoverable test evidence only.
